title: Colophon
summary: How this personal internet is put together. This is a site note, not an essay in Ryan’s voice.
body:
This site is a new build. The previous github.io page was removed from the working tree at Ryan’s request. It remains in git history.

Pages share one content directory of JSON files checked by a schema. Drafts stay out of the public site and out of the sitemap. The admin can edit those files only when the server has a writable disk and an admin password.

A follower count appears only with a source and a date. Statements he makes about a vulnerability, a patent, a line count, or a hackathon stay in his words. They are not converted into verified awards.
byline: Site colophon, not a personal essay

seo.description: How Ryan Editraj’s personal internet is structured, and what it refuses to invent.
